title: kith-peer: outbound HTTPS client to peer mailbox
description:
What: Implement an async HTTPS client in kith-peer that posts a JMAP Peer/deliver or Peer/receipt request to a peer mailbox and returns the parsed response.

Algorithm:
1. Define PeerHttpClient struct wrapping a hyper_util::client::legacy::Client<HttpsConnector<HttpConnector>, Full<Bytes>>
2. In PeerHttpClient::new(): build HttpsConnector via HttpsConnectorBuilder::new().with_webpki_roots().https_only().enable_http1().build(); build Client via Client::builder(TokioExecutor::new()).build(connector)
3. Define fn build_jmap_request(method: &str, args: serde_json::Value) -> serde_json::Value: constructs { using: [...], methodCalls: [[method, args, "0"]] }
4. Define async fn deliver(url: &str, message: &DeliverPayload, sender_user_id: &str) -> Result<(), PeerDeliveryError>:
   a. Validate url starts with "https://" (not http); else PeerDeliveryError::InsecureUrl
   b. Build JMAP request body via build_jmap_request("Peer/deliver", serialize message args)
   c. Build hyper Request::builder().method(POST).uri(url).header(content-type, application/json).body(Full::from(body_bytes))
   d. Call client.request(req).await with a 30-second timeout via tokio::time::timeout
   e. On timeout: return PeerDeliveryError::Timeout
   f. Check response status: non-2xx -> PeerDeliveryError::HttpError(status)
   g. Collect response body via BodyExt::collect().await -> PeerDeliveryError::NetworkError on Err
   h. Parse JSON; check methodResponses[0] for error invocation vs success; return Ok(()) on accepted=true
5. Define PeerDeliveryError enum: InsecureUrl, Timeout, NetworkError(String), HttpError(StatusCode), PeerRejected(String), InvalidResponse

Defensive rules:
- MUST validate URL starts with https:// (step 4a); reject http:// silently with typed error
- MUST NOT follow redirects: use Client default (hyper does not follow redirects by default); verify
- MUST apply 30-second timeout (step 4d); no infinite hangs
- MUST NOT log request body (contains message content)
- MUST NOT log full URL in errors (may contain hostname); log only error category
- TLS certificate verification is ON by default with webpki_roots; do NOT disable
- PeerDeliveryError must be non-exhaustive to allow future variants without breaking callers

Agent team: Researcher R checks hyper-util Client builder and hyper-rustls connector pattern in the codebase (see kith-tslocal for hyper unix socket pattern). Implementer I writes PeerHttpClient. Tester T writes unit tests with a mock HTTPS server using axum in the test binary. Validator V runs cargo test -p kith-peer + clippy.

Tests (oracle = hyper/rustls crate docs + kith-architecture.md):
- https:// URL succeeds (mock server at localhost responds with 200 + valid JMAP response) -> Ok(())
- http:// URL -> PeerDeliveryError::InsecureUrl without making any network call
- Timeout (mock server hangs) -> PeerDeliveryError::Timeout within 31 seconds
- Non-200 response (mock returns 500) -> PeerDeliveryError::HttpError(500)
- Peer rejects (methodResponses contains error invocation) -> PeerDeliveryError::PeerRejected
